# Smart Museum Guidance System 

**Selected theme-**  
**Area 1:** Protecting, Preserving, and Sharing Cultural Heritage  
**Area 3:** Experiencing Art and History with Robots

## Functionality

1. Guide visitors  
2. Show the direction of the robot (App)  
3. Artefact protection (health monitoring) (humidity, temperature, Gas)  
4. Quality inspection with picture (Esp32)   
5. Bangla Alphabet teaching (Language Centre)  
6. Visitor count display (Mobile QR CODE) — shows how many groups/people have entered.  
7. Bangla / English mode — the robot can switch languages for its messages.  
8. Restricted-area alert (Also relates to the AI Guard) — if someone goes where they should not, the alarm robot reacts. (ir sensor, face ditection)  
9. Queue/line-up instruction — the guide robot tells visitors to wait and move in order.  
10. Confidence display — shows how sure the AI Guard is about the face recognition. ( robot eye)  
11. Emergency — the robot will guide the visitor to the nearest and safest EXIT during a disaster.(follow the shortest path)  
    

ছোট্ট মিউজিয়ামের গেটে একটা ট্যাবলেট/পোস্টার বোর্ড আছে — সেখানে দেখানো হয় কতজন গেস্ট ভেতরে আছে (কাউন্টার ডিসপ্লে)। গেস্ট ঢুকলে ওয়েলকাম রোবট "AI গাইড" এক্টিভ হয় — বাটন চেপে বাংলা বা ইংলিশ মোড বেছে নেওয়া যায়। রোবটটা লাইন ধরে মিউজিয়ামের একেকটা স্টেশনে (আর্টিফ্যাক্ট) থামে, স্পিকারে গল্প বলে, তারপর পরের স্টেশনে যায়। রোবটের গায়ে একটা ছোট ডিসপ্লে/LED অ্যারো দেখায় সে এখন কোন স্টেশনে আছে ও কোনদিকে যাচ্ছে। একটা "নিষিদ্ধ এলাকা"র সামনে গেলে RFID/সেন্সর চেক করে — অনুমতি না থাকলে বাজার (বাজার/অ্যালার্ম) বেজে ওঠে। জরুরি অবস্থায় (বাটন বা সেন্সর ট্রিগার) রোবট সবাইকে সবচেয়ে কাছের এক্সিটের দিকে গাইড করে। 

At each station, the robot will:

1. Detect the RFID tag.  
2. Stop the motors.  
3. Update its location.  
4. Tell the track controller which station it reached.  
5. Turn on that station’s LED.  
6. Display the station name.  
7. Play the selected language recording.  
8. Take one image.  
9. Send the image to the dashboard.  
10. Wait briefly.  
11. Turn off the station LED.  
12. Continue to the next station.

Sections:

1) App \- 

has 2 users:  
i) admin, which will have features such as viewing all artifact health(sensor data), visitor count, 

ii) visitor will have features such as robot location tracking

2) Authentication Section \-

Their pre-built system with facial recognition that Displays the AI's confidence level for each face recognition. Helps staff understand how certain the AI is before allowing or denying access for restricted section entry.

3) Robot \- 

Language selection on display and button.  
Will be able to go through the pre-determined track.   
There’ll be stoppages, on which our robot stops  (RFID) and play pre-recorded brief about different centers.  
It will take image on every point everytime it will visit and send it to the Admin(App).

On an emergency call, The robot will skip all exhibit stops and follow the emergency exit route, while continuing to stop for people or obstacles. 

4) The track \-

The track itself will have LEDs and buzzers. Whenever the robot comes in front of the center, led infront of the center will remain on.   
On an emergency call, all the LEDs will blink and the buzzer sounds simultaneously until the robot goes to exit point. 

## **Final physical sections**

| Section | Main purpose |
| ----- | ----- |
| Visitor gate | QR access and physical visitor counting |
| Guide robot | Movement, navigation, narration and image requests |
| Exhibit stations | Artifact displays and environmental monitoring |
| Smart track | Station lighting, emergency warning and route |
| Authentication gate | Restricted-area access demonstration |
| Admin app | Monitoring, images, alerts and emergency control |
| Visitor app | Robot location, exhibit information and instructions |

# **Main Users**

## **A. Visitor**

The visitor can:

* Scan a QR code to open the visitor application for entry  
* Select Bangla or English  
* See the museum map  
* View the robot’s current station  
* See what is the robot explaining(as text)  
* See the next station  
* Receive queue and waiting instructions  
* Receive emergency evacuation instructions

The robot’s location can be displayed as:

* At Station 1  
* Moving from Station 1 to Station 2  
* At Station 2  
* Moving toward Exit

This information comes from RFID station detection.

## **B. Museum Administrator**

The administrator can:

* Secure log in  
* View current visitor count  
* See robot status and location  
* View artifact health (temperature, humidity) See health status as green, yellow, or red  
* View the latest & all images taken at each exhibit  
* View restricted-area access attempts  
* Activate emergency mode  
* Reset the emergency after evacuation  
* Check whether devices are online or offline

## **C. Museum Staff**

Authorized staff can:

* Request access to a restricted area  
* Look at the camera  
* See recognition result and confidence  
* Enter when access is approved

# **Tools: Application Platform**

**Frontend:** Responsive Web App (js)  
**Backend:** Firebase  
**Database:** Firebase Realtime Database  
**Image storage:** Firebase Storage  
**Facial Authentication:** Lego set’s AI guard (standalone)  
**Guide Robot:** ESP32 for movement and communication, ESP32-CAM for image capture.  
Linear/custom rail system or Five-channel IR line sensor OLED with button, DFPlayer Mini ,sd card Audio amplifier & Speaker, RC522 RFID reader mounted underneath the robot  
Passive RFID tags under each station, Front obstacle sensor  (optional), Battery , buck.
